generation.mode: built-in ImageGen edit with edit-target as Image 1 and style canon as reference-only Image 2

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by the uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; water and its four immediate neighbours are excluded, as are gradients below 12 luminance units.
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No whole-cell sun gradient or cast-shadow field is visible, but basalt columns repeatedly have pale caps over darker side faces and conifer crowns retain directional light-dark modelling. The aggregate statistic does not establish the literal equal-value rule.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: Manual estimated fraction of non-water land area at native source resolution.
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: Broad coherent moor benches count as buildable; exposed column faces and stacks count as steep; talus, shingle, boulders, scrub, and conifers make up the remainder. Approximate uncertainty is plus or minus 0.08 per fraction.

east.required: island ground across the edge, with the inherited tarn retained

crown.method: Manual width census of every visually distinguishable conifer crown, including saplings, dense-group crowns, and edge-clipped crowns; native median 35.5 px scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 4.8 cm per final pixel.

waterMask.encoding: Opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha.
waterMask.componentNote: The large component is the open sea with the complete source-visible surf and wash zone; the second is the retained east-edge tarn.
waterMask.method: Flooded source-raster teal and blue from the image edges, grew through adjacent source-painted pale surf and wash, retained the separate east-edge tarn, and removed sub-16-pixel water specks. Dry cliffs, talus, stacks, and skerries remain transparent terrain.

refusalReasons: Land occupies 841 north-edge pixels and 827 south-edge pixels; both edges are required to be open sea.
The moor continues roughly 55-70 m from the east edge in much of the source instead of ending at the required 15-40 m shore band.
Repeated pale basalt caps over darker column faces and directionally modelled conifers violate the literal neutral-lighting rule.
Three distinct offshore stacks are present instead of the permitted one or two.
Several cliff runs read as repeated upright columns with clean level caps rather than consistently broken, split, leaning, weathered coast geology.
Conifers were introduced well west of the authored neighbour arrival instead of being limited to vegetation that continues from that paint.
openRisks: The water mask is mechanically complete against the delivered source, but it faithfully preserves the source candidate's noncompliant north and south edge topology.
Buildable and steep fractions and the crown census are manual image measurements rather than surveyed geometry.
No second ImageGen call was made because the returned source was square and the task authorizes a retry only for non-square framing.
Seam continuity and overall visual quality remain director and owner judgments; this report does not claim visual acceptance.
